company.name: Flexport
company.shortDescription: Flexport provides an end-to-end global logistics platform that coordinates freight movement from manufacturers to delivery destinations.
company.description: Flexport offers ocean and air freight services, customs brokerage, trucking coordination, and fulfillment solutions for both direct-to-consumer and business shipments. Its technology platform delivers shipment tracking, SKU-level visibility, cost management tools, and centralized documentation across international and domestic supply chains. Flexport also supports customs clearance and trade compliance through brokerage services and data-driven insights.
